author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Legion Tab Gen 3 is a high-tier gaming tablet that provides a lot of versatility: use it as a tablet in and of itself, or add a controller to make it a big-screen handheld.  Let's take a closer look at this option and see whether it's worth it for you.

Buy one here: https://www.lenovo.com/us/en/p/tablets/android-tablets/legion-tab-series/lenovo-legion-tab-gen-3/zaef0068us

* Note: you can also import the Chinese variant (Y700), often for cheaper. But unless the reseller ships it with the Global ROM, it'll be in Chinese and may cause some issues with Google certification unless you flash the Global ROM yourself.  For that reason, I recommend checking legit options for your region first.

Android starter guide: https://youtu.be/I4mqgcDYZFo
Low-end tablet video: https://youtu.be/_gH6jupChWs
